logRetentionHelp: Rules apply to file families, including numbered or dated names. The active file is always retained.
logApplicationDescription: Server requests, errors, warnings and application operations. Names such as app.1.log and app.2.log are rotations of the same source.
logCodexDescription: Technical JSON-RPC exchanges with the agent engine: requests, responses and notifications. This diagnostic log is not conversation history. Enabling retention splits it into archives at the selected size.
logOtherDescription: Other files: contents not automatically identified, with no automatic deletion.
logApplicationRotation: The application opens a new file approximately every 10 MiB.
logRetentionDeletionWarning: After saving, archives exceeding the age OR count limit will be permanently deleted at the next automatic pass (about one minute). Unknown files, symbolic links and conversation history are never deleted.
logRetentionSaveFailed: Could not save the retention policy.
logStorageEstimateHelp: Total log file size on the server, including technical logs not displayed here, regardless of filters. Refreshed every 30 seconds.
